title: Predicting Out-of-Distribution Generalization of Neural Operators via Observable Spectral Error Decomposition
abstract: arXiv:2609.23529v1 Announce Type: new  Abstract: Neural operators have emerged as powerful surrogates for solving partial differential equations (PDEs), yet their reliability under distribution shift remains a critical barrier to deployment. Existing approaches to out-of-distribution (OOD) generalization in operator learning are largely empirical and black-box: they report aggregate error metrics without explaining why errors arise or when they will grow. We propose a structure-preserving framework that makes OOD generalization predictable and auditable. Our key idea is to parameterize the learned solution operator as a spectral filter $h_\theta(\lambda)$ acting on the eigenvalues of the underlying elliptic operator, implemented via Chebyshev polynomial expansions and trained with a weak-form objective. This parameterization admits an exact decomposition of the energy-norm error into two observable components: a model-dependent spectral approximation term and a distribution-dependent s

translated_title: 通过可观测谱误差分解预测神经算子的分布外泛化
translated_abstract: 神经算子已成为求解偏微分方程（PDE）的强大代理模型，但其在分布偏移下的可靠性仍然是实际部署的关键障碍。现有的算子学习分布外（OOD）泛化方法在很大程度上是经验性和黑盒式的：它们仅报告聚合误差指标，却不解释误差为何产生或何时会增长。我们提出了一个结构保持框架，使OOD泛化变得可预测且可审计。我们的核心思想是将学习到的解算子参数化为作用于底层椭圆算子特征值的谱滤波器 $h_\theta(\lambda)$，通过切比雪夫多项式展开实现，并采用弱形式目标函数进行训练。这种参数化使得能量范数误差能够被精确分解为两个可观测的组成部分：一个依赖于模型的谱逼近项和一个依赖于分布的（摘要在此处被截断）
tldr: 提出一种结构保持框架，将神经算子参数化为作用于椭圆算子特征值的谱滤波器，从而将能量范数误差精确分解为可观测的谱逼近项与分布相关项，使神经算子的分布外泛化变得可预测、可审计。
en_tdlr: A structure-preserving framework that parameterizes neural operators as spectral filters acting on elliptic operator eigenvalues, enabling exact decomposition of energy-norm error into observable components to make out-of-distribution generalization predictable and auditable.
